hypothesis: BTC-only strategy path with fresh predeclared gate
why_it_exists: BTCUSDT is central to the project and earlier in-sample BTC evidence was supportive, but the holdout BTCUSDT result failed.
failure_it_addresses: Separates BTC-specific behavior from the failed 19-market basket and prevents BTC hopes from being inferred without testing.
data_needed: BTCUSDT 4h only, same final unit-fixed source, fresh predeclared chronological holdout or new-data extension; no use of BTCUSDT_1h unless separately scoped.
pass_definition: BTC-only holdout positive, PF >= 1.10, sufficient trade count, drawdown acceptable versus prior BTC evidence, and no reliance on a few outlier trades.
caution_definition: BTC positive but PF 1.00-1.10, small trade sample, or top trades dominate outcome.
fail_definition: BTC negative, PF < 1.00, drawdown expands materially, or result depends on a tiny number of trades.
forbidden_to_avoid_overfitting: Do not reuse the failed Long1-only BTC holdout as support; do not tune thresholds after seeing BTC results; do not convert BTC-only success into basket claims.

why_it_exists: Long1-only reference strength did not transfer to holdout, suggesting regime dependence.
failure_it_addresses: Attempts to avoid periods where the long-only signal degrades rather than assuming one global regime.
data_needed: Same 19-market 4h data with predeclared regime labels from existing indicators only; ideally later/new data for confirmation.
pass_definition: Filtered holdout improves aggregate PnL/PF and BTCUSDT while preserving enough trades and market breadth.
caution_definition: Aggregate improves but breadth or trade count becomes thin, or performance is concentrated in only majors.
fail_definition: No holdout improvement, BTC remains weak, or filter simply removes losing markets post-result.
forbidden_to_avoid_overfitting: No threshold sweep; no post-result regime definitions; no choosing only favorable dates/markets.

why_it_exists: Holdout weakness may include repeated re-entry after adverse exits or short lifecycle compression behavior.
failure_it_addresses: Targets overtrading and clustered losses after failed trades without changing core entry signal.
data_needed: Trade lifecycle/event outputs from existing validation or a future predeclared instrumentation run; no new strategy patch before plan approval.
pass_definition: Predeclared cooldown reduces holdout losses and drawdown while keeping aggregate and BTC positive with adequate sample size.
caution_definition: Losses reduce but PnL becomes flat or trade count collapses.
fail_definition: No improvement, lower PF, BTC still negative, or improvement only from excluding many trades after seeing outcomes.
forbidden_to_avoid_overfitting: No cooldown length sweep; no per-market cooldown tuning; no selecting cooldown based on best backtest.

hypothesis: Anti-chase entry filter using distance from EMA/ATR
why_it_exists: Failed holdout may include entries after price extension where reward/risk is already poor.
failure_it_addresses: Attempts to reduce late entries into stretched moves.
data_needed: Predeclared distance metrics at entry using existing EMA/ATR features, chronological holdout, and BTC/basket reporting.
pass_definition: Filter improves holdout PF and BTCUSDT without excessive concentration or trade-count collapse.
caution_definition: Improves some weak markets but worsens BTC or majors, or relies on one distance threshold.
fail_definition: No holdout improvement, PF remains below 1.00, or only positive through post-result threshold selection.
forbidden_to_avoid_overfitting: No ATR/EMA distance threshold sweep; no market-specific distance tuning; no cherry-picked favorable markets.

hypothesis: Volatility compression / ATR percentile entry filter
why_it_exists: Signal quality may differ by volatility state; raw Long1-only failed across the holdout.
failure_it_addresses: Tests whether entries during predeclared volatility states avoid noisy or exhausted conditions.
data_needed: Existing ATR series and predeclared percentile bands from reference only, then applied unchanged to holdout.
pass_definition: Holdout aggregate and BTC positive, PF >= 1.10, market breadth reasonable, and concentration not worse.
caution_definition: Aggregate positive but concentrated or BTC mixed.
fail_definition: Aggregate negative, BTC negative, or percentile band chosen after seeing holdout.
forbidden_to_avoid_overfitting: No percentile sweeping; no changing bins after results; no treating one volatility pocket as final strategy without validation.

why_it_exists: Prior evidence showed majors stronger than large/smaller alts, while basket holdout failed.
failure_it_addresses: Separates possible major-market behavior from weaker alt behavior without deleting losers post-result.
data_needed: Predeclared families such as majors, large alts, smaller/alts; chronological holdout within each group.
pass_definition: A predeclared family passes its own holdout gates and does not depend on post-result market selection.
caution_definition: One family positive but sample size or concentration is weak.
fail_definition: Families fail holdout, BTC fails, or family choice changes after seeing outcomes.
forbidden_to_avoid_overfitting: No choosing only winning symbols; no external liquidity claims without data; no merging family success into all-market claim.

hypothesis: Weak-market exclusion framework only if predeclared before testing
why_it_exists: DOGE and other weak markets hurt robustness, but post-result removal is invalid.
failure_it_addresses: Tests whether a rule-based exclusion framework can be validated without cherry-picking.
data_needed: Predeclared exclusion criteria based only on information available before validation; separate holdout or new-data check.
pass_definition: Framework improves holdout aggregate, BTC boundary remains acceptable, and exclusions are rule-based rather than symbol-picked.
caution_definition: Improves PnL but breadth shrinks too much or rule excludes many difficult markets.
fail_definition: No robust improvement or exclusions are effectively post-result cherry-picks.
forbidden_to_avoid_overfitting: Do not remove DOGE/DOT/UNI because they lost; do not build rules from holdout losers; no symbol-by-symbol survivor list.

why_it_exists: After failed holdout and unacceptable dry-run evidence, doing nothing may beat weak strategy continuation.
failure_it_addresses: Creates a conservative benchmark before spending more research effort on marginal candidates.
data_needed: Existing validation metrics, dry-run PnL records if already saved, and no new market data unless separately approved.
pass_definition: A future candidate must clearly beat no-trade on holdout and BTC boundary after costs/risks are considered as research metrics.
caution_definition: Candidate beats no-trade only slightly or only in reference period.
fail_definition: Candidate loses in holdout or offers no clear research advantage over staying flat.
forbidden_to_avoid_overfitting: Do not frame infrastructure uptime as strategy edge; do not continue dry-run because service works; do not ignore opportunity to stay flat.
